notes.title: State of the Game
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Just wanted to give a quick state of the game update and inform about the latest updates to State of Extinction.  We have been on a hiatus after the last patch as we felt it brought much needed stability to the quest structure, AI logic and inventory management.  

Finally, we are getting back on the grind to add the last quests, NPCs, etc which will move us from the, "Early Access" label to "Full Release"!  

However, as you know game development is an ongoing process, so we will be bringing out patches to get to the final state.   Thanks for your patience as we continue to build you a solid game.


State of Extinction Dev Team

notes.title: State of the Game
notes.content:
Hello Everyone, 

We just wanted to give a quick, "State of The Game" message to communicate what's currently cooking with State of Extinction.

First, the team took a quick hiatus from enhancements and development in January to catch up on some non-development items.  However, during this time we did take the opportunity to discuss what we need to work on next as we move to upcoming content, implementation on new platforms (Linux and Mac) and localization.  

Expect more updates soon where we will be dropping new content as well as squashing any bugs along the way.  Thanks again for your interest and support in the game!


Development Team
Stone Pixel Games, LLC.

notes.title: State of the Game
notes.content:
Ancient men and women of Old!  First, we would like to wish you all a happy and safe New Year!  We had planned to drop a patch (v167)  today, but decided that we want to squeeze in a few more updates so the next patch will be released on Monday Jan 2, 2017.  

We are excited as the next patch will include more streamlined dialogue.  Meaning, we significantly reduced a lot of the conversation you will be having with NPCs so it's more direct and to the point.  In addition, we have more updates coming to quests, enemy NPC AI, and sound effects to name a few in the v167 patch.

If you have not already, check out the new story trailer which shows upcoming game play footage, along with a few new beasts.  

Have a Happy New Year!

-SoE Development Team

notes.title: State of the Game
notes.content:
Hello Ancient Men (and Women) of Old and Renown! State of Extinction (SoE) has been receiving a lot of growth and interest in it's, "Early Access" infancy.  We want to say, Thank you for being part of the early sun rise of SoE, as it makes its way up over the horizon.  

We plan to release another patch in the next few days that will fix a lot of game play issues providing a more solid,"Early Access" game play experience.  

Please remember that SoE is still in an, "Early Access" game build state and there are bugs, broken items, etc. that maybe found.  Being a small (very small) indie studio making a, "first of it's kind" prehistoric I-RPG based game requires feedback from you, the tribe members.

We want to hear from you, so please feel free to post in the Discussion forum or email us at the SoE Website on any game play elements, changes, etc. you think should be improved, removed or even added to the game as we continue to enhance your experience!  

We want to make sure SoE is enjoyable for everyone.  Thanks again for your interest and support in SoE.

notes.title: Early Access, Now Available!
notes.content:
State of Extinction developed by indie studio Stone Pixel Games, LLC is a, “first of its kind” isometric RPG set in the Antediluvian (Pre-Flood) world of Early Man.   

The State of Extinction – Early Access build does not contain the entire storyline as new content will be released periodically for free for those who have decided to start there, “Calling” in Early Access.

Key Early Access Build Features Include:

•	Over 60 Quests spanning across 2 Regions
•	1 Playable Tribe
•	Hardcore Mode
•	360 Degree Rotatable Camera
•	Dynamic Day/Night Cycle
•	4 (out of 10) Story Chapters Available
•	Player Driven decisions that will shape your, “Calling”  
•	Gathering and, “Making”  Weapons and Hides
•	Execution of Spirit Speaking Skills
•	Automatic Content upgrades 

Get the State of Extinction - Early Access build and start your, “Calling” now!

State of Extinction - Early Access build will be released on [b][u]November 29, 2016[/u][/b]!  However, please note that we, as gamers ourselves understand that having a quality game play experience is imperative and we want to ensure this in State of Extinction. Thanks so much for your support and interest in State of Extinction.

notes.title: Story Concepts
notes.content:
Today we will focus on the importance of story and how it’s shaped in State of Extinction.  The story of State of Extinction revolves around the challenging life of early man, during a time where evil and corruptness was not governed nor controlled.

You play the role of a young naive tribesman from the tribe of the Wolf.  Your home is a cave located deep in the mountains of Eagles Reach which has kept you and your tribesmen isolated from the rest of the world.
 
However, your journey will ultimately take you out of the mountains where you will encounter many different types of people with different backgrounds, religions and beliefs.  You will be forced to make difficult decisions in which you must ultimately live with.
 
State of Extinction uses dialogue text, narration and on screen action to deliver, “Mature” story themed content.  Mature themed content revolves around experiences such as interacting with a cannibalistic tribe, to addressing men who fornicate with beasts presented in a manner where you decide on how to address the situation.

 The goal of the story telling approach is to allow you to determine how to address many early man situations and decide what is considered right or wrong.  Choices you make will ultimately affect the type of ending you will experience in the game.

Whatever choice you make as you encounter various scenarios will ultimately leave a footprint on you, but more importantly your role in humanity’s salvation.

State of Extinction is a first of its kind action/adventure RPG based game for PC (Mac/Linux coming soon) set in a science-fantasy antediluvian world of early man.  An Early Access release is targeted for late October 2016.

notes.title: State of Extinction Update!
notes.content:
Development has been going very strong on State of Extinction.  I have to first apologize for not providing updates as we have wanted.  But I do want to ensure you that the game is still being built and will be released.  

Now coming up from coding to catch the fresh air, the breeze feels great and we are ready to give the world a, “new” experience in RPG based gaming!

State of Extinction has been reworked a lot to include a ton of new enhancements as we get closer to a polished Early Access release.  Listed below are the latest enhancements to the game build.  You can also see new screen shots posted on Steam and other media outlets such as Facebook and Twitter.  

Expect a ton of new information over the next few weeks regarding the various systems that have been enhanced to provide you with a new Prehistoric mature based experience.  Thanks for your support and joining us on the journey.

-Benjamin
SoE Dev Lead


State of Extinction Enhancements
•	Included Min-Map to assist with Navigation (shows Large Beasts and Fire locations)
•	Enhanced Prehistoric world with additional hand-drawn environments
•	Updated NPCs logic and interact capabilities 
•	Added Special Dialogue camera when interacting with NPCs
•	Added statistics for tracking kills, herbs consumed, quest completed and other key data
•	Enhanced overall story line and plot to explore dark areas that prehistoric man should not be engaged in
•	Enhanced overall graphics to included detailed plants, wild life, rocks etc.
•	Enhanced controls to allow movement and UI navigation via mouse point-n-click; no need to use a keyboard 
•	Enhanced UI to provide a clean, easy to use interface to improve overall game play experience   presenting a prehistoric era
•	Working with a AAA Composer to develop a, musical soundtrack to capture the essence and feel of on-screen game play
